name: Aminata Diallo
action: Aminata pauses while finishing with her tools, then looks at Moussa and says, "I can come for a little while, but I’ll have to leave early."
reason: Her first impulse was to hesitate and resist, wanting to refuse or postpone in order to protect her exhausted body, her study time, and her way home. Reflection softened that impulse by making Moussa’s past help and the value of neighborhood ties more salient, while keeping the memory of last year’s long, burdensome celebration firmly in view. Because the revised tendency was a careful, limited acceptance with guarded boundaries, she answers politely rather than flatly refusing, preserving goodwill while signaling that she cannot give the whole evening. This fits her generally reserved, cautious style and her habit of managing obligations without exposing more than necessary.
